items.title: 66095_Benny Carter oral history interview
items.q: And wasn't there a Ralph somebody at that time, I think, in that group?

ctx.x: They were all based in London, yes. I had an English player named Ray Webb on guitar; George Chisolm on trombone.
Yeah. And wasn't there a Ralph somebody at that time, I think, in that group?
No, there was a Cliff Wood Wildridge who played the other trumpet.
